title: 第23章 惊现魔修第24章 曾经也有个疼我的爷爷
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
月黑风高，阴云密布。
平静的饲兽场席卷了常人难以察觉的波动。
所有凶兽匍匐在地，瑟瑟发抖，却不敢发出半分声响。
饲兽员靠在凉棚内打盹，丝毫未察觉到危机已经到来。
苏星河负手立于棚顶，俯瞰整个饲兽场，最终将目光锁定在了一处。
那里浓烟弥漫，让原本漆黑的夜晚，如同被黑洞吞噬，两道身影若隐若现。
苏星河可以察觉到，对方也正在观察着自己。
苏星河气息收敛，将修为压制在炼气二层，上次汲取灵净瓶中精纯灵力时，无意中发现，它还有隐匿气息的功能，只要苏星河刻意引导，即可将丹田气海中的灵力，隐藏在灵净瓶中。
“原来不是妖兽！”
察觉到对方散发的灵力波动，并不强，苏星河脚下一点，直奔对方而去。
离的近了，苏星河才发现此处弥漫的并非浓烟，而是血雾，并且正在缓慢被来人吸收。
一头凶兽被开膛破肚，全身干瘪，精血枯竭。
感受着浓烈的血腥气息扑鼻，苏星河并不畏惧，只是腹中翻涌，想要呕吐。
“何方神圣？”
苏星河皱着眉，这种诡异的场景，还是第一次遇到。
“你不怕？”一个干涩的声音从血雾中传来，没有理会苏星河的询问，而是好奇的反问。
苏星河能察觉到血雾中的力量波动，与灵力类似，却又不完全一致，但从力量波动中可以察觉到，对方大概炼气二境的修为。
他身旁之人着女装，看不清面容，力量波动明显弱了不少，只有炼气一层的修为，比刚踏入炼气境的穆婉清，到要强上不少。
苏星河发现，随着自己修为的提升，对周遭的感知力，也越来越清晰，如果唤作为达到三层时，无法清晰判断出对方准确修为。
“怕？应该是们怕！”苏星河缓缓凝聚灵力，随时动手，既然摸清了对方实力，又对自己没有任何威胁，那就尽快解决。

“你也是炼气二层？不错，比之前那个废物强一些，但你并不是我的对手，我不想杀你，别自寻死路！”沙哑的声音传出，有恃无恐。
苏星河丝毫不怀疑对方所言，虽然血雾弥漫，的确没有丝毫杀意，从以往看来，对方每次出手也只是针对凶兽，没有伤人先例。
“看你未曾伤人的份上，我饶你们一次，只要保证以后，再不来行凶，拿出让我满意的赔偿，此事就此揭过！”
“赔偿？你说来听听？”似乎觉着苏星河的要求有些天真，对方笑着反问。
“十颗炼气丹，或者等价物品！”
“炼气丹？我们血修不用这种垃圾！精血，充满力量的精血才是最好的补药！”
“血修？”苏星河第一次听说。
“又是一个无知小儿，滚吧！再不滚我可忍不住要吸干你了！你比它们可要大补的多！”周身血雾萦绕，看不清真实面容的血修，沙哑的声音略有停滞，似乎真是忍耐不住了。
“你也不过炼气二层，就算加上他，又能奈我何？”
如果说今晚之前，苏星河只是二层修为，又第一次遇到这诡异的血修，会心里没底，可此时已经突破到炼气三层，绝对的实力碾压下，心里只剩下对新鲜事物的好奇。
content_en:
The moon is dark, the wind is high, and the clouds are thick.
The calm animal farm was shaken by fluctuations that were difficult for ordinary people to detect.
All the ferocious beasts were lying on the ground, shivering, but did not dare to make any sound.
The animal keeper was taking a nap against the pergola, unaware that the crisis had arrived.
Su Xinghe stood on the roof of the shed with his hands behind his hands, overlooking the entire livestock farm, and finally fixed his gaze on one spot.
Thick smoke filled the air there, making the originally dark night feel like it was being swallowed by a black hole, with two figures looming.
Su Xinghe could sense that the other party was also observing him.
Su Xinghe restrained his aura and suppressed his cultivation to the second level of Qi Refining. The last time he absorbed the pure spiritual power from the Lingjing Bottle, he accidentally discovered that it also had the function of concealing aura. As long as Su Xinghe deliberately guided it, he could hide the spiritual power in the sea of ​​​​Qi in his Dantian in the Lingjing Bottle.
"It turns out it's not a monster!"
Sensing that the spiritual power fluctuations emitted by the opponent were not strong, Su Xinghe stepped forward and ran straight towards the opponent.
As he got closer, Su Xinghe discovered that the place was not filled with thick smoke, but blood mist, which was slowly being absorbed by the visitor.
A ferocious beast was disemboweled, its whole body was shriveled, and its essence and blood were exhausted.
Feeling the strong smell of blood hitting his nostrils, Su Xinghe was not afraid, but his stomach was churning and he wanted to vomit.
"Who is this?"
Su Xinghe frowned. This was the first time he encountered such a strange scene.
"Aren't you afraid?" A dry voice came from the blood mist. He ignored Su Xinghe's inquiry and asked curiously.
Su Xinghe could detect the power fluctuations in the blood mist, which were similar to spiritual power, but not exactly the same. However, he could detect from the power fluctuations that the opponent was probably at the second level of Qi Refining.
The person next to him was dressed in women's clothing, his face could not be seen clearly, and his power fluctuations were obviously much weaker. He was only at the first level of Qi refining, which was much stronger than Mu Wanqing, who had just entered the Qi refining realm.
Su Xinghe discovered that as his cultivation level improved, his perception of the surroundings became clearer and clearer. If the summoning action reached the third level, he would not be able to clearly judge the opponent's accurate cultivation level.
"Afraid? You should be afraid!" Su Xinghe slowly gathered his spiritual power and took action at any time. Since he knew the opponent's strength and did not pose any threat to himself, he decided to deal with it as soon as possible.
"Are you also on the second level of Qi Refining? Yes, you are better than the waste before, but you are no match for me. I don't want to kill you, so don't seek death!" came the hoarse voice, confident.
Su Xinghe did not doubt what the other party said. Although the blood mist was filled with blood, there was indeed no killing intention. From the past, it seemed that every time the other party took action, he only targeted ferocious beasts and had no precedent of hurting anyone.
"Seeing as you have never hurt anyone, I will spare you this once. As long as you promise not to commit murder again and provide me with satisfactory compensation, this matter will be over!"
"Compensation? Can you tell me?" As if he felt that Su Xinghe's request was a bit naive, the other party asked with a smile.
"Ten Qi Refining Pills, or equivalent items!"
"Qi Refining Pill? We blood cultivators don't need this kind of rubbish! Blood essence, blood essence full of power is the best tonic!"
"Blood cultivation?" Su Xinghe heard this for the first time.
"Another ignorant kid, get out! If you don't get out, I can't help but suck you dry! You are much better than them!" Xue Xiu, who was surrounded by blood mist and couldn't see his true face, said his hoarse voice was slightly stagnant, as if he couldn't bear it anymore.
"You are only at the second level of Qi Refining. Even if you add him, what can you do to me?"
If Su Xinghe was only at the second level of cultivation before tonight, and he would have been unsure when encountering this weird blood cultivation for the first time, but now he had broken through to the third level of Qi Refining, and was overwhelmed by the absolute strength, leaving only curiosity about new things in his heart.
